title: Veterans claim free ChatGPT Plus subscriptions
excerpt: Over 20,000 veterans and transitioning service members have received a free year of ChatGPT Plus to aid their career transitions.
body_html:
More than 20,000 transitioning service members and veterans have successfully claimed a free one-year subscription to ChatGPT Plus. The initiative provides these individuals with access to advanced tools to help them prepare for civilian careers.

Usage in Career Transitions

Participants are utilizing the platform to assist with various aspects of their transition into the civilian workforce. The program highlights how advanced artificial intelligence can support professional development and career planning for those leaving military service.
